claim_status: post-review analysis frozen before WP2-WP10 outputs

wp2.selection_rule: first three frozen units in each cohort order; all biological pairs retained for a selected unit

wp3.calibration_basis: thresholds frozen from numerical pilot before full WP1 biological-unit results
wp3.gate_aggregation: direction mean within biological pair; median of biological pairs within independent unit; family median across independent units
wp3.gate_rule: all method-arm-intervention family medians must pass; unit pass fractions remain descriptive

wp6.near_zero_policy: mark non-estimable; do not repair with an arbitrary pseudomass

wp5.aggregation: direction mean within pair; pair median within independent unit; cohorts and manual-layer donors reported separately

wp7.baseline_source: reuse WP1 and WP4 frozen outputs
wp7.label_free_rigid: PCA orthogonal candidates selected only by symmetric coordinate Chamfer distance; no witness or label input
wp7.her2_oracle: exact truth-correspondence coordinate upper bound; HER2ST controlled pairs only; never described as deployable

wp8.eligible_gene_universe: stored 600-gene cost-plus-heldout panel for each frozen pair
wp8.source_only_rule: rank eligible features by source-only variance with deterministic gene-name tie break; first 500 cost and remaining 100 held out
wp8.random_rule: uniform permutation of the frozen eligible universe; first 500 cost and remaining 100 held out
wp8.aggregation: splits are repeated analyses within independent units and never counted as new biological units

wp9.risk_direction: larger values always indicate higher risk
wp9.mass_deficit_definition: 1 - fitted_row_mass / frozen_uniform_source_mass; negative values are retained
wp9.published_method_specific_scores: not run without independently verified source definition

wp10.barycentric_tissue_scale: diagonal length of the target-coordinate bounding box
wp10.severity_curve_status: enhanced analysis requiring newly generated within-patient variants; not counted as additional biological units
wp10.random_reference: embedded in NEX-AURC and prevalence baselines
wp10.claim_boundary: controlled model-external correspondence and crop truth, not real adjacent-section biological ground truth

prohibitions: select implicit-differentiation units using observed outcomes
treat numerical cross-validation as independent biological evidence
